Fridges must stay at 5°C or below. Check and log them at opening and at 14:00. If a fridge reads between 5°C and 8°C, move the stock to another fridge and check again after 30 minutes. If it reads above 8°C for more than 2 hours, throw the stock away and call your manager.

# Accidents and incidents

Any injury to a colleague or a customer, however small, must be reported on form IR-7 before the end of the shift. Your branch manager sends it to Ines Duarte within 24 hours.

Near misses count too. A wet floor that almost caused a fall is still an incident worth recording.

[equipment-repairs.md]
# Equipment repairs

If equipment breaks, first put an out-of-order sign on it. Then phone the equipment service contractor listed for your branch. Give them the machine's serial number from the plate on the back.

Log every repair call in StaffHub under Maintenance. Repairs under £200 can be approved by a branch manager. Anything over £200 needs Ines Duarte's approval.
